spells.name: Nightstick
spells.desc: The baton comes off the belt. Deals WEAK physical damage to an adjacent enemy and Staggers them.

spells.name: Taser
spells.desc: Two prongs, fifty thousand volts. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 3 tiles and Stuns them for a round.

spells.name: Slap Leather
spells.desc: Hand hovers, then it doesn't. MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Staggered targets take it worse. Hits harder on anyone who already made their move.

spells.name: High Noon
spells.desc: One bullet, fired at noon, bounces off every wall on the map before it finds them. HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy through any cover. Always a critical hit. Deals bonus damage to Staggered or Roped targets.

spells.name: Fan the Hammer
spells.desc: Six shots from the hip. Deals WEAK physical damage to every enemy next to you.

spells.name: Kneecap Shot
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Rooted.

spells.name: Soothe
spells.desc: A hand on the brow. It does not fix you; it keeps you going. Heals an ally a MEDIUM amount and gives them Regen for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Heal
spells.desc: Restores a LARGE amount of HP to a Single Ally. Heals more on allies below 40% HP.

spells.name: Temporal Tide
spells.desc: Time runs thick in the water. Creates a 3×3 zone for 2 rounds: allies inside heal a WEAK amount and shed 1 debuff at the end of each round; enemies inside are Slowed.

spells.name: Revive
spells.desc: Revives a fallen ally. Works once per unit per match.

spells.name: Tube Feet
spells.desc: A thousand little suckers. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy within 2 tiles and Roots it for a round.

spells.name: Water Jet
spells.desc: A hard jet of water from the open hand. WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 3 and it is Wet for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges.

spells.name: Meow
spells.desc: An adorable, disarming meow. All enemies within 2 tiles have their DEF lowered for 3 rounds. Deals no damage.

spells.name: Ninefold Scratch
spells.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs to an empty tile up to 3 away, in any direction.

spells.name: Big Kick
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and kicks them 2 tiles back.

spells.name: Cryptid Vanish
spells.desc: Was it real? The photo's blurry... Teleport 2 tiles, invisible 2 turns.

spells.name: Entangling Roots
spells.desc: The ground remembers what it grew. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and Roots them for a round.

spells.name: Sasquatch Smash
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. The photo would have been blurry anyway. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Herbal Remedy
spells.desc: Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses 2 debuffs.

spells.name: Thornlash
spells.desc: A bramble whip wraps the legs. WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy and Roots it for 1 round.

spells.name: Arcane Sigil
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies in an X-shaped AOE.

spells.name: Spellsteal
spells.desc: Reach into an enemy's mind and rip out a spell. Steal one of the target's spells — they lose it, you learn it for the rest of the match. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.desc: Something small and harmless. Ribbit. The target is Silenced for 1 round and its ATK drops by 1 stage.

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.desc: Stop every molecule in the target's body. The world whites out, a crystal lattice locks around them, and time itself freezes before the shatter. Deals HEAVY magic damage to a Single Enemy and FREEZES them solid. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

spells.name: Static Shock
spells.desc: A crack of static across the gap. MEDIUM magic damage, and the jolt scrambles their link (Jammed for 3 rounds).

spells.name: Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Howl
spells.desc: The pack answers. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 ATK stage.

spells.name: Feral Dive
spells.desc: From higher ground, leaps down onto a Single Enemy below you, dealing MEDIUM physical damage.
Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Automatically strikes the visible enemy with the lowest HP.
spells.name: Blood Frenzy

spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. The caster leaps in first.
spells.name: Pounce
Tail Whip
spells.desc: A spinning tail strike. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.
Dashes through the battlefield. Applies Stagger. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Ram Charge
Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed or Staggered targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside fall into Discord (ATK and DEF lowered).

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.

spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed or Staggered targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside fall into Discord (ATK and DEF lowered).

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.
